capabilities.label: Graph Extraction
capabilities.description: Source graph extraction, audit orchestration, and usable architecture snapshots.

levels.name: No architecture target
levels.description: Architecture Cartographer cannot resolve or extract a graph for the target scenario.
levels.capability_summary: No usable architecture graph is available.
levels.next_unlock: Readable scenario source and graph extraction without tool errors.

levels.name: Graph extraction available
levels.description: The provider can produce a graph snapshot and run audit orchestration.
levels.capability_summary: A graph snapshot can be extracted for architecture checks.
levels.next_unlock: Fresh snapshots and audit evidence suitable for downstream detectors.

levels.name: Audit evidence usable
levels.description: Graph extraction and audit evidence are usable for boundary, surface, and intent checks.
levels.capability_summary: Architecture evidence is available for provider-owned checks.

levels.name: Graph posture clean
levels.description: Graph extraction has no provider-owned blocking findings.
levels.capability_summary: Graph extraction is clean enough for recurring audit use.

capabilities.label: Domain Authority
capabilities.description: Curated domain authority, trust ladder confidence, and parseable domain documentation.

levels.name: Authority missing
levels.description: The target scenario lacks enough domain authority for architecture findings to be interpreted against an intentional map.
levels.capability_summary: Architecture ownership cannot be trusted yet.
levels.next_unlock: A readable domain authority source such as docs/concepts/DOMAINS.md.

levels.name: Authority discovered
levels.description: Domain authority exists or can be inferred, but confidence or parse quality is still weak.
levels.capability_summary: Architecture ownership can be inspected with caveats.

levels.name: Authority trusted
levels.description: Domain authority is curated or sufficiently high-confidence for architecture findings.
levels.capability_summary: Architecture findings can be routed to intentional domain owners.

levels.name: Authority clean
levels.description: Domain authority is readable, trusted, and free of provider-owned parse warnings.
levels.capability_summary: Domain authority is clean enough for recurring drift monitoring.

capabilities.label: Boundary Integrity
capabilities.description: Import cycles, layering violations, cross-scenario private imports, coupling smells, and mislocated files.

levels.name: Boundary checks unavailable
levels.description: Boundary detectors cannot run against usable graph and domain evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Boundary integrity cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Graph and domain evidence sufficient for deterministic boundary checks.

levels.name: Boundary drift visible
levels.description: Boundary detectors can surface stable findings with codes, locations, and domains.
levels.capability_summary: Boundary drift is visible and routeable.
levels.next_unlock: Deterministic blocker and error boundary findings resolved.

levels.name: Deterministic boundaries controlled
levels.description: No deterministic blocker or error architecture findings remain in active code paths.
levels.capability_summary: Deterministic architecture boundaries are controlled.
levels.next_unlock: Heuristic boundary debt eliminated or deliberately suppressed.

levels.name: Boundary posture clean
levels.description: Boundary integrity has no provider-owned blocking or debt findings.
levels.capability_summary: Architecture boundaries are clean enough for fleet validation.

capabilities.label: Surface Coherence
capabilities.description: Declared API, CLI, UI, and implementation surfaces agree with domain authority and archetype expectations.

levels.name: Surface comparison unavailable
levels.description: Surface evidence cannot be compared across domain authority, implementation folders, CLI groups, and UI features.
levels.capability_summary: Cross-surface architecture drift cannot be evaluated.

levels.name: Surface drift visible
levels.description: Convergence and surface-coherence findings are stable enough to route.
levels.capability_summary: Cross-surface drift is visible.
levels.next_unlock: Missing, stale, or undeclared surfaces reconciled.

levels.name: Surfaces aligned
levels.description: Declared and observed surfaces agree with domain authority.
levels.capability_summary: API, CLI, UI, and implementation surfaces are aligned.

levels.name: Surface posture clean
levels.description: Surface coherence has no provider-owned drift findings.
levels.capability_summary: Surface coherence is clean enough for recurring drift monitoring.

capabilities.label: Intent Alignment
capabilities.description: PRD and requirement intent claims align with owned domains, operational targets, and domain vocabulary.

levels.name: Intent checks unavailable
levels.description: Intent claims or domain authority are unavailable for alignment checks.
levels.capability_summary: Intent alignment cannot be evaluated.
levels.next_unlock: Requirement and PRD claims plus trusted domain authority.

levels.name: Intent drift visible
levels.description: Intent alignment findings are stable enough to route to domains and requirements.
levels.capability_summary: Intent drift is visible across requirements and domains.
levels.next_unlock: Requirements, operational targets, and domain vocabulary reconciled.

levels.name: Intent aligned
levels.description: Intent claims align with product domains and operational targets.
levels.capability_summary: Requirements and domain ownership are aligned.

levels.name: Intent posture clean
levels.description: Intent alignment has no provider-owned drift findings.
levels.capability_summary: Intent alignment is clean enough for recurring architecture audits.
